einzeiler: Old Gods of Appalachia announces Goth Prom in Asheville on October 31st.
kurzfassung: Old Gods of Appalachia hosts a special Goth Prom event in Asheville, North Carolina on October 31st. The evening features music by DJ Poltergeist, a prom royalty crowning ceremony, and appearances by various cast members and creators. Limited pre-show meet and greet tickets are available as an add-on to general admission.
stichpunkte: Old Gods of Appalachia presents Goth Prom in Asheville, North Carolina on October 31st
Prom royalty crowned by the hedge witch
Special appearances by members of the cast
Exclusive merch table available at the event
Doors open at 7pm, main event starts at 8pm
Optional pre-show meet and greet begins at 5pm
Meet creators Steve Schell and Cam Collins alongside cast members
Tickets and limited meet and greet add-ons are available now via show notes
beschreibung:
There’s a story whispered in these hollers that speaks of the ones who never got their proper prom — how they wait, patient as roots, for the night the veil goes thin enough to try again. This Halloween, that night comes to Asheville, North Carolina.

On October 31st, Old Gods of Appalachia drags Eulogy down into the dark for a night unlike any other — fog curling low across the floor, candlelight flickering like it’s afraid of something just outside the door. DJ Poltergeist commands the decks, spinning deep cuts that sound like they were pulled straight up out of the mountain itself. Prom Royalty will be chosen and crowned by the hedge witch and yours truly, in a ceremony older and stranger than any homecoming court you ever knew in high school.

Keep your eyes on the crowd... members of the Old Gods of Appalachia cast may creep among the revelers (as schedules permit). Before you leave, the merch table waits, offering the opportunity to carry a little piece of the dark home with you.

The doors don’t open until 7pm, and the night doesn’t truly begin until 8, but for those who want to kick things off early, a pre-show meet & greet begins at 5pm. Extend your evening with early access to the venue, and enjoy the exclusive opportunity to chat with the cast. Meet creators Steve Shell and Cam Collins; the voice of Granny White, Betsy Puckett; the voice of Polly Barrow, Tracey Johnston-Crum; the voice of Granny Underwood, Stephanie Hickling Beckman; the voice of Glory Ann Boggs, Allison Mullins; and the voice of Conrad Barrow, Cecil Baldwin. With special appearance by season six cast member and New York Times bestselling author Don Martin (Verity Vox and the Curse of Foxfire). Tickets are limited and sold as an optional add-on to your general admission ticket.

So dig out the taffeta, the lace, the fishnets, and all your black t-shirts. Dress in your finest and most fiendish. Because down here, the mountain remembers every monster who never got to go to prom — and tonight, they will.
